sketch.build.summary: Build a named sketch using the existing shapes geometry/constraint/dimension schema (GM06 v1).

inputs.name: Unique sketch name; collisions fail before creation.
inputs.geometry: Named existing primitives plus ellipse {center,majorRadius,minorRadius,angle?} or {center,majorAxisPoint,minorAxisPoint}. Radii are not full axis lengths. All coordinates are three length expressions.
inputs.plane: Native construction plane reference; default XY, supports XZ/YZ.
inputs.frame: sketch (default): local XY coordinates independent of selected plane.
inputs.constraints: Existing type/entities commands using local labels and .start/.end/.center/.fitN selectors. Ellipses expose .majorAxis/.minorAxis lines; rectangles expose .edge0..edge3 and their endpoints.
inputs.dimensions: Existing type/entities/expression/text?/orientation? commands plus majorRadius/minorRadius. Use angle between ellipse.majorAxis and an explicit reference line for native orientation.
inputs.positions: Signed through-zero native bindings: [{name,point: local selector,coordinates: [x,y,0]}]. Creates expression-driven component datum planes, point and linked projection. Requires parametric history; helper names must be unique.
inputs.inferencePolicy: explicit (default): only requested agent constraints; native: accept native primitive constraints. Both preserve SDK-created constraints and neither changes global UI inference preferences. Use dimension-plan to review further proposals.
inputs.profileIndex: Optional nonnegative selection hint for downstream shapes recipes.

limitations: Extends shapes.py, not a second DSL. Primitive input expressions seed geometry; explicit dimensions/constraints provide persistent bindings. Position frame coefficients are sampled at creation: rebuild/review bindings after changing the support-plane frame. Native solver/ellipse-to-loft acceptance remains open; see docs/GM06.md. No global rollback.

sketch.transform.summary: Translate/rotate selected current sketch entities with solver-respecting native Sketch.move.

inputs.frame: Required sketch; local XY on any support plane including XZ/YZ.
inputs.translate: Three length expressions, local z must be zero.
inputs.rotate: {angle: angle expression,center?: three length expressions}; default center is sketch origin. Right-handed about sketch +Z, rotate first then translate.

limitations: Snapshot edit, not a persistent transformation equation. No scaling/reflection, constraint deletion or automatic retries. Returns whole-sketch before/after and solver conflicts; partial changes may remain. Native XZ/YZ frame acceptance is pending.

sketch.dimension-plan.summary: Read-only reviewable dimension proposals for circles, ellipses, rectangles and explicit relations, recognizing existing constraint identities.

inputs.entities: Optional selected sketch refs; omitted uses sketch curves.
inputs.relations: Optional explicit requested type/entities constraints: horizontal, vertical, parallel, perpendicular, concentric, equal, coincident, horizontalPoints, verticalPoints. Count is bounded by maxEntities.
inputs.tolerance: Recognition length expression, default 0.000001 cm; positive, at most 0.01 cm.
inputs.maxSeconds: Positive numeric recognition budget in seconds, at most 120, default 10. Checked between SDK reads and inside recognition loops; cannot interrupt a single blocking SDK read.

limitations: Does not create geometry, dimensions, attributes or constraints. Proposals are snapshots, not a solver feasibility guarantee. Recognizes analytic circles/ellipses and isolated closed four-line rectangles, including rotated rectangles. Reports unrecognized constraint types. Existing radius/diameter and opposite rectangle-side dimensions prevent duplicates. Plan stores document identity and a conservative state fingerprint; edits invalidate it.

sketch.dimension-apply.summary: Apply explicitly accepted proposal IDs from an unchanged reviewed GM06 dimension plan.

inputs.sketch: Same native sketch as the plan.
inputs.plan: Exact result.plan returned by sketch.dimension-plan; identity, fingerprint and regenerated proposals are checked before mutation.
inputs.accept: Nonempty unique proposal ID array, e.g. [p1,p2]; no implicit accept-all.

limitations: Use the actual returned plan, not the illustrative example placeholder. Stops on first solver conflict and reports completed/notApplied/before/after; no constraint deletion, rollback or retry. Re-plan after application; new plans recognize existing dimensions.
